marketing_description: The Philips Professional Series LED Bulb, part number 571471, offers a soft white light with a color temperature of 2700 K and a Color Rendering Index (CRI) of 90. This dimmable bulb is Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant, providing a long-lasting solution with an average life of 15000 hr. It is designed to replace a 75 W incandescent bulb and features easy installation.
